hooks.name: Warn when the exported GLB exceeds the 15 MB budget
hooks.description: Enforces the mobile loading budget from the blender spec (under 15 MB) whenever a model is written.

action.command: f=$(ls -t app/static/models/*.glb | head -1); s=$(stat -f%z "$f"); echo "$f is $((s/1048576)) MB (budget 15 MB, hard cap 50 MB)"; if [ "$s" -gt 15728640 ]; then echo "WARNING: over budget. Re-run blender/scripts/optimize_glb.sh or reduce textures/props." >&2; fi
